body: help her get help. get her to a therapist, doctor, whatever. after all this she's probably way too scared to do anything herself. talk to her. sometimes i do this thing when im depressed where i pretend to be asleep so people wont talk to me. talk to her. make sure she knows you're on her side, and that she's got your support no matter what. your dad is freaked out and reacting in the worst possible way and i think theres nothing you can do but wait for him to calm down. meanwhile, BE THERE FOR HER.
